cases.purpose: Compare recursive dump and names/value filters with empty, multiline, unterminated, and write-only files in a private tmpfs tree; include named reads. Probe EACCES as an unprivileged user separately from mode-bit write-only handling.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix. The tree is a tmpfs created by the fixture; the real /proc/sys returns when the side ends.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
T=/tmp/ptree; /usr/bin/mkdir -p $T && /usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=1M rf-sys $T || echo SETUP-FAILED
cd $T && /usr/bin/mkdir -p abi kernel/random net/ipv4/conf/lo vm
echo 1 > abi/vsyscall32; echo Linux > kernel/ostype; echo 'rf.domain' > kernel/domainname
printf '4\t4\t1\t7\n' > kernel/printk; : > kernel/random/empty; printf 'line one\nline two\n' > vm/multi
echo 0 > net/ipv4/ip_forward; echo 1 > net/ipv4/conf/lo/forwarding; echo secret > kernel/wo; /usr/bin/chmod 0200 kernel/wo
echo denied > vm/denied; /usr/bin/chmod 0400 vm/denied
printf 'unterminated' > vm/no_newline; printf 'first\nlast' > vm/mixed; echo hidden > vm/no_owner_read; /usr/bin/chmod 0044 vm/no_owner_read
cd /tmp; /usr/bin/mount --bind $T /proc/sys || echo SETUP-FAILED
N="/usr/bin/setpriv --bounding-set=-dac_override,-dac_read_search -- $BASH --noprofile --norc -c"
d() { $N "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
d all "sysctl -a"
d all-upper "sysctl -A"
d names "sysctl -a -N"
d values "sysctl -a -n"
d pattern "sysctl -a -r '^net\.'"
d pattern-names "sysctl -a -N -r 'o(stype|main)'"
u denied-dump "sysctl -a -r '^vm\.denied$'"
u denied-names "sysctl -a -N -r '^vm\.denied$'"
d write-only "sysctl kernel.wo"
d no-owner-read "sysctl vm.no_owner_read"
d empty "sysctl vm.no_newline kernel.random.empty"
d value-unterminated "sysctl -n vm.no_newline"
d mixed "sysctl vm.mixed"
d names-hidden "sysctl -a -N -r '^(kernel\.wo|vm\.no_owner_read|vm\.no_newline)$'"
/usr/bin/umount /proc/sys; /usr/bin/umount $T
